name: Lucid Fury
body:
Your bloodrage does not interfere with the skills you have truly mastered.

Prerequisite(s): Bloodrage

Benefit(s): Choose a skill you cannot normally use while bloodraging. You may now do so and gain a +2 bonus in that skill while not bloodraging. At 7th and again at 15th level, you may choose an additional skill to use with this feat.
